methods: OLS with calendar-month fixed effects and HAC/Newey-West uncertainty (12-month maxlag)
classic seasonal Mann-Kendall with within-month independence assumption and autocorrelation diagnostics

augmentation.sample_weight_policy: For each base sample, clean weight=1 and all accepted synthetic variants sum to weight=1.

comparisons.limitation: Equal-station monthly composite versus area-weighted gridded bbox mean; not collocated; NOAA QCU source streams overlap other networks and no independence is claimed.
External station corroboration only; these values did not enter model fitting, selection, calibration, or the final-test score. Point-network and gridded-bbox support differ.
Cross-product comparison, not independent ground truth: CHIRPS blends station observations and its satellite inputs share parts of the broader GPM/IMERG ecosystem.
Published station means versus area-weighted gridded bbox mean; changing station support and no value-level QC flags; PDFs have rights reserved; do not redistribute the extracted observations.
Equal-station monthly total versus area-weighted satellite/gridded total; available yearbooks only, changing station support and no value-level QC flags; do not redistribute extracted observations.

landsat.evidence: The selected public USGS STAC item resolved to an HTTP 200 HTML login page (Content-Type text/html; 33,066 bytes), not a Landsat science file. No Landsat metric is reported.

INAMHI_yearbooks.rights_note: INAMHI yearbook pages reserve rights; source PDFs and extracted station values are not included in the GitHub release.

final_test.interval_caveat: Validation also selected the model, so test interval coverage is descriptive and not a split-conformal guarantee.
final_test.process_access_caveat: Earlier development code preloaded held-out rows before selection but did not fit, tune, select, predict, or report test metrics with them. This is recorded in phase2_execution_failures.jsonl; strict process blinding is not claimed.

ingestion_cache.io_limitations: OS-level disk read/write counters are not portable in this Windows run; bytes read are estimated from matched partition sizes or full Gold size. CPU and wall times are measured per call.

limitations: Final test contains 36 monthly targets and a prior development run preloaded held-out rows before model selection; fitting and selection did not use those rows, but strict process blinding is not claimed.
The 90% residual interval achieved 55.6% empirical coverage on the test and is not a calibrated guarantee.
No OLS-HAC trend remains significant after Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment; trends are descriptive and noncausal.
The preliminary pilot bbox is not an administrative, Coast, Andes, Amazon, or external-region mask.
NOAA/INAMHI station means and gridded area means have different spatial support; CHIRPS shares station inputs and is cross-product corroboration.
INAMHI source PDFs reserve rights and are excluded from the GitHub release.
The bounded Landsat STAC asset returned login HTML, not a science raster; no Landsat comparison was possible.

predictive_validation.selection_rule: minimum clean validation MAE, then RMSE, then protocol model order; robustness holdout not used for selection
